subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: After the stale guard assertions are repaired, do workflow and security owners approve executing this grouped set of privileged third-party action revisions on the final exact head?
rationale: Automated checks can verify syntax and assertion consistency, but they cannot accept new third-party code receiving credentials, write access, publishing access, agent API keys, or security artifacts.

options.title: Repair and approve grouped update
options.body: Synchronize the assertions, review the exact upstream revisions, and approve the final head as one dependency batch.

options.title: Split privileged revisions
options.body: Separate token issuance, Codex, CodeQL, and container-publishing upgrades for narrower owner review.

options.title: Pause the dependency batch
options.body: Keep the PR open until Dependabot access and privileged revision review are stable enough for final validation.

recommendation.title: Repair and approve grouped update
recommendation.body: Synchronize the assertions, review the exact upstream revisions, and approve the final head as one dependency batch.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the strongest individual coordinator from CODEOWNERS provenance and direct PR engagement, while openclaw/openclaw-secops owns the security-specific workflows.
